name: Management by Walking Around (MBWA)
excerpt: Management by Walking Around involves managers talking to employees to see how a project is progressing.
notes: Management by Walking Around (MBWA) is a management style where managers walk around in an unstructured manner through the workplace, engaging with employees to understand how projects are progressing and to identify any issues firsthand.
context_summary:
- Managers engage with employees.
- They assess project progress.
- Issues are identified firsthand.
